title: Intraoperative EEG dataset during medianus-tibialis stimulation with 8 different rates
description: Intraoperative EEG recordings of somatosensory evoked potentials (SEP) elicited by median and tibial nerve stimulation at eight different stimulus repetition rates. The dataset includes 14 adult and 4 pediatric subjects, with continuous EEG split into sessions by nerve and side and into runs by stimulation rate. Processed derivatives are also provided. The data were used to assess how stimulation rate affects the signal-to-noise ratio of short-duration SEP recordings.
methods_description: Continuous intraoperative EEG was recorded in parallel to SEP stimulation of the median and tibial nerves (left/right), with one run per stimulation rate. Stimulus artefacts were detected after high-pass filtering at 200 Hz and used as triggers to define sweeps (50 ms for median, 100 ms for tibial SEP). Data were resampled to 1200 Hz, and sweeps with amplitude >10 µV were rejected. Random subsets of sweeps corresponding to recording durations up to 20 s were used to calculate SNR. Data were converted to BIDS with bids-starter-kit and custom Matlab scripts.
